scope: Raw DROID camera/telemetry calibration and geometric novel-view lower bound
summary: One pinned raw DROID episode now has verified telemetry, camera extrinsics, SVO intrinsics/distortion, metric depth samples, and calibrated wrist-to-two-exterior depth-splat baselines; rights and held-out lineage remain blocked.
evidence: Five raw files total 46,338,367 bytes and match every pinned GCS MD5 and local SHA-256.
All 77 HDF5 datasets contain 338 aligned finite rows, including 6D commanded/measured Cartesian state, 7D joints, gripper, three camera extrinsics, and camera/control timestamps.
Exterior camera extrinsics are static; wrist translation/euler ranges are 0.4913 m/1.2977 rad and its gripper offset is exactly constant.
ZED 5.1 reports matching serials, 1280x720 intrinsics/distortion, meter depth, and three sampled depth maps per camera.
Exterior-1 depth splatting covers 3.78% of pixels with visible PSNR 7.46 dB; exterior-2 covers 3.05% with visible PSNR 9.10 dB.
lessons: The original Euler implementation used the wrong composition order; matching DROID's scipy Rotation.from_euler('xyz') convention is necessary for any valid projection.
Even calibrated visible-surface splatting leaves most target pixels occluded and is only a geometry lower bound, not a complete generator.
limitations: The official raw DROID dataset license is still unverified.
This episode has no proven mapping to LeRobot DROID-100 episodes 21, 60, or 77.
The result cannot enter the Strict-W benchmark or public training set.
next_actions: Obtain an official dataset license and recover held-out raw UUID mappings from the RLDS-100 episode metadata before running claim-eligible GEN3C/ReCamMaster comparisons.
